description: A React component for rendering and managing an application form within Mattermost, including validation, submission, lookup, and UI rendering logic.

classes.name: AppsForm
classes.description: React component class for rendering and handling an application form with validation, submission, and dynamic UI updates.

methods.name: validateDateFieldValue
methods.description: Validates date or datetime field values, warns if datetime format is used for date fields.

methods.name: validateAppField
methods.description: Performs validation on individual AppField objects, including date, datetime, and time interval constraints.

methods.name: getSafeDateValue
methods.description: Returns a sanitized date string, extracting date portion if datetime format is detected.

methods.name: createSanitizedField
methods.description: Creates a sanitized copy of an AppField, fixing invalid time intervals and date values.

methods.name: initFormValues
methods.description: Initializes form values with defaults and current time for required datetime fields.
